europe_now.title: Germany deploys fighter jets to Latvia
europe_now.summary: Germany is sending fighter jets to Latvia during the upcoming election period to bolster security amid ongoing regional drone threats. The decision highlights heightened military readiness among European allies facing airspace incursions.

sources.headline: Germany to send fighter jets to Latvia during election amid drone threat

europe_now.title: Hague tribunal convicts former Kosovo leader
europe_now.summary: An EU-backed court in The Hague has convicted former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci of war crimes, reopening sensitive political wounds across the Western Balkans. The verdict prompted widespread reactions and shock throughout the region.

sources.headline: Shock in Kosovo as Hague convicts former President Thaci
Former Kosovo leader is war criminal rules EU-backed court, tearing open old Western Balkans wounds

top_stories.title: EU Proposes Associate Membership for Canada
top_stories.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has pitched an unprecedented associate membership status for Canada, catching several European governments by surprise. The initiative aims to deepen the partnership between the European Union and Canada.

sources.headline: Can Canada and the EU build a deeper partnership?

top_stories.title: Debate Over Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Safety
top_stories.summary: Industry leaders and policy figures are actively debating the appropriate regulatory frameworks required for advanced artificial intelligence models. Discussions center on balancing innovation, transparency mandates, and long-term safety concerns.
